title: Early Missionary Calls: Voices from a Century Ago
author: Brittany N. Alleman Ayers and Ed Riding

footnotes.text: More than 35,000 responses to these mission calls have now been indexed and can be discovered in the Church History Library catalog (catalog.ChurchofJesusChrist.org) by searching “Missionary calls” and the name of the missionary candidate. In the quotations used in this article, spelling, punctuation, and capitalization have been standardized for the sake of readability and emphasis.
